author: Arnav
problem: An API rate limiter sees requests at the given times (seconds, in order). It accepts a request only if at least gap seconds have passed since the last request it accepted. Return the times of the accepted requests.
bug_description: Uses t - last > gap instead of >=, so a request exactly gap seconds after the last accepted one is rejected.

comments.accurate: Accepts a request once gap seconds have passed since the last accepted one
comments.wrong_behavior: Accepts a request only when more than gap seconds have passed since the last accepted one
comments.wrong_location: Gap check verified; last should probably also move forward on rejected requests
